explanation: The act where Jesus appointed the twelve disciples to go out and proclaim the message of the kingdom.
The kingdom of heaven, God's rule that has drawn near and will be fulfilled in the world.
The deep dread or anxiety one may feel when facing danger or persecution because of their faith.
Someone who gives testimony to the truth, here specifically the disciples who bear witness to Jesus' life and teaching.
To subject someone to unfair treatment, threats, or violence because they believe in Jesus.
To judge a person in court; in this chapter it refers to both human courts and God's final judgment.
The quality of enduring difficulties, suffering, or persecution without giving up one's faith.
The eternal existence that Jesus promises to those who endure in faith until the end; also the physical life they may lose during persecution.
